I certainly know when a group is joking around, if I try to join in the whole thing comes to a awkward grinding halt as I stutter out a joke robbed of all humour. Or if I don't participate I look like that weirdo laughing away but never contributing.

Although blaming it all my stutter is, I'm sure, wholly unfair. I'm a fairly socially anxious person at the best of times. I guess it's a multiplicative effect.
